description.zh:
保证请求幂等性，从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。

ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见[如何保证幂等性](~~25693~~)。

> 若用户未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样。
description.en:
A client-generated, case-sensitive token that you can use to ensure the idempotency of the request. The token must be unique for each request.

It must be an ASCII string with a maximum length of 64 characters. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

>  If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the request ID as the client token. The request ID may be different for each request.
The ID of the export directory for the protocol service.

description.zh:
文件系统ID。

- CPFS：必须以`cpfs-`开头，例如cpfs-125487\*\*\*\*。

- CPFS智算版：必须以`bmcpfs-`开头，例如bmcpfs-0015\*\*\*\*。
- CPFS  SE：必须以`cpfsse-`开头，例如cpfsse-022c71b134\*\*\*\*。
description.en:
The ID of the file system.

*   The IDs of CPFS file systems must start with `cpfs-`. Example: cpfs-125487\*\*\*\*.
*   The IDs of CPFS for Lingjun file systems must start with `bmcpfs-`. Example: bmcpfs-0015\*\*\*\*.
*   The IDs of CPFS SE file systems must start with `cpfsse-`. Example: cpfsse-022c71b134\*\*\*\*.

description.zh:
每次查询结果的个数。

取值范围：10~100。默认值：20。
description.en:
The number of results for each query.

Valid values: 10 to 100. Default value: 20.

description.zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，您可以使用NextToken再次发起请求，获取从当前截断位置之后的内容。
description.en: A pagination token. It can be used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results.
The ID of the protocol service.

title.zh: 查询协议服务导出目录信息

example.unifiedCli: aliyun nas get-protocol-mount-target --next-token M18xMA== --max-results 20 --file-system-id cpfs-099394bd928c0000 --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --protocol-service-id ptc-197ed6a00f2b0000 --export-id exp-19abf5beab8d0000 --region cn-hangzhou
